description: Deliberately crude preschool-like crayon cartoon: broken scribbled outlines, patchy fill with paper showing, oversized crooked head, tiny body, concise story-relevant settings and expressive action.

use_only: visual hierarchy, depth, interaction and readable negative space
broken scribbled crayon texture and patchy fill
do_not_copy: the reference's specific gate, guard, badge or ordered scene
exact furniture arrangement, pose sequence or framing copied as a whole
text, watermark, signature, logo, or handle
reference_policy.conflict_resolution: Resolve every conflict in this order: immutable character identity, story-required wardrobe and footwear, then style. Style may control only background density, palette, texture, mood, and composition; it must not alter a character's face, hair, beard, skin tone, body proportions, or expression grammar.

linework.quality: Use badly drawn scribbled crayon contours with visible gaps and wobble; do not copy the reference scene, text, prop, pose, signature, or watermark.

paper_texture: Warm off-white paper with patchy crayon fill and plenty of paper showing through.

palette.rule: Use these colors and restrained lighter or darker tints only. Do not introduce a dominant hue outside this family unless the user explicitly requests it.

background.rule: Follow references/visual-rules.md scene policy: use concise recognizable settings and purposeful props, with no fixed prop count. Flat fields are available for emphasis, not required for every panel. Keep action, faces and text readable.

emotional_tone: Playful, awkward physical comedy with deadpan reactions.
lighting: flat, readable, and continuous across adjacent panels
composition: mobile-first, one focal action, broad negative space for later speech bubbles, and no incidental detail competing with the subject

information_card_policy.apply_to: new information cards and newly planned motion information overlays
information_card_policy.activation: write information_card.style explicitly in new scripts; absent style preserves historical rendering
information_card_policy.reference_use: composition reference only; do not add lettered preview to generated-art style references
